description: Dark band along fracture lines in the GeoCrack photographs and in synthetic frames, measured with one code path
paper: main text Section 4.3 (first paragraph); supplement S4, comparison with real photographs (two tables)

dataset.name: GeoCrack
references: Ansari, Mohammed Yaqoob, 2024. GeoCrack: A high-resolution dataset of fracture edges in geological outcrops (version 1.0) [data set]. Harvard Dataverse. https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/E4OXHQ

Yaqoob, M., Ishaq, M., Ansari, M.Y., Konagandla, V.R.S., Al Tamimi, T., Tavani, S., Corradetti, A., Seers, T.D., 2024. GeoCrack: A high-resolution dataset for segmentation of fracture edges in geological outcrops. Scientific Data 11, 1318. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-04107-0
dataset.used: 49 photographs with their edge masks (listed in per_image.real); no file of the dataset is redistributed, this record holds statistics only

log10_width_over_spacing.name: log10 of the relative width (dark-band width / median spacing of adjacent lines of the image)

background_variation.name: fine-scale brightness variation of the background, one value per image

notes: The photographs carry no pixel size: real and synthetic images are compared in pixels and in dimensionless quantities only.
Annotation: mask converted to 8-bit grey, values > 0 (the weak values of anti-aliased edges included); the line is its Zhang-Suen skeleton, which need not lie at the centre of the dark band.
Measurement points: every 8th line pixel in row-major order, not equally spaced along the lines; points with fewer than 3 line pixels within 6 px are skipped.

Profile: half length 63 px whatever the pixel size, step 0.25 px; surrounding part |s| >= 47.25 px, centre part |s| <= 6.3 px; brightness = Rec. 709-weighted 8-bit sRGB values. The widths are not readings of the ruler of records/fine_width_formal.json (half length 0.40 m, mean of R, G and B, every line pixel).

The two synthetic groups are reported separately and never pooled. The 50 frames of the aerial group come from 5 viewpoints, so their measurement points are not independent. The overcast frames of the close-range viewpoints (a0019, a0021) are not used.

Spacing of adjacent lines: first hit of the 3 x 3-dilated line raster along the two normal directions (8 to 512 px, step 0.5 px); directions without a hit are not counted, so the spacing is biased low; an image with fewer than 30 hits has no spacing. summary.log10_width_over_spacing gives the quantiles of the logarithm and, under "ratio", those of the ratio itself (the relative width of the paper).

Background: real, all pixels more than 20 px from the annotation mask (vegetation, sky, shadow and unmapped fractures may be included); synthetic, valid pixels more than 20 px from the target, unclear (U) and occluded lines and the opening-class pixels.

Histograms are counts of measurement points (background_variation: of images); values outside the range are counted in the end bins. overlap = sum over the bins of min(count_a / total_a, count_b / total_b): the overlapping coefficients of the pooled points can be recomputed from the histograms; the quantiles (median, iqr, p5, p95), the coverage and overlap_image_equal_weight cannot.

Comparable subset: measurement points with a dark-band width of at least 3 px. overlap.*.*.comparable_subset compares the real subset with all synthetic points; both_sides_comparable restricts both sides.

Points without a dark band (brightness difference below 2 grey levels) have no width. Along a manual annotation they include offsets of the annotation, closed fractures and fills brighter than the surrounding rock, which this measurement cannot tell apart.

checks.skeleton: the thinning used here equals skeletonize of the label program on a 512 x 512 crop of every mask. checks.ruler: band_measure with the parameters of records/fine_width_formal.json reproduces six rows of that record exactly.

real.description: GeoCrack photographs, skeleton of the manual annotation mask

synthetic_aerial.description: frames of the multi-illumination aerial set (block C of the frame list), target layer

synthetic_close_range.description: sunlit close-range frames at 2 mm/px (a0018, a0020), target layer
